name: Razer Naga V2 HyperSpeed
description: Razer Naga V2 HyperSpeed (1532:00b4). Set up this mouse guides actual input capture and review. Identify then selects captured buttons, wheel scroll and tilt.

inputs.label: Left button
inputs.note: Only "Mouse button" can be assigned here (to swap left and right, for example), so a mistake can't lock you out of clicking.

inputs.label: Right button
inputs.note: Only "Mouse button" can be assigned here, so a mistake can't lock you out of clicking.

inputs.label: Wheel scroll up
inputs.note: Positive (up) ordinary and high-resolution wheel events identify this position.

inputs.label: Wheel scroll down
inputs.note: Negative (down) ordinary and high-resolution wheel events identify this position.

inputs.label: DPI stage up
inputs.note: Upper-left DPI stage control. Capture its actual input in setup; its current onboard assignment may emit no evdev event. No onboard settings are written.

inputs.label: DPI stage down
inputs.note: Upper-left DPI stage control. Capture its actual input in setup; its current onboard assignment may emit no evdev event. No onboard settings are written.

inputs.label: Scroll mode button
inputs.note: The current onboard scroll-mode assignment may emit no evdev input. Setup can skip it without changing firmware or existing mappings.

inputs.label: Forward button
inputs.note: Compatibility slot for existing Forward assignments, not a claim that the upper-left DPI controls emit BTN_EXTRA. Actual captured positions take precedence.

inputs.label: Back button
inputs.note: Compatibility slot for existing Back assignments, not a claim that the upper-left DPI controls emit BTN_SIDE. Actual captured positions take precedence.

inputs.label: Legacy DPI assignment
inputs.note: Existing generic DPI assignments are preserved here. Use the separate upper-left DPI stage up/down positions for guided setup.
